assistant_markdown:
Converted the sorcery into a white creature that still embodies the
“reckoning” feel when you’re behind on board. It keeps the conditional
cost reduction and now has an ETB removal that only works when
outnumbered, aligning with Spike-friendly, fair play and a conservative
power level. Added appropriate creature types and P/T.

modified_card_json.name: Keeper of the Ledger
modified_card_json.text: This spell costs {2} less to cast if an opponent controls at least two more creatures than you. When Keeper of the Ledger enters the battlefield, destroy target creature an opponent controls if its controller controls at least two more creatures than you.
